job.name: ig34_host
job.style: Photorealistic cinematic still, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
job.style_qa: фотореализм, мужчина ~42 на записи подкаста, микрофон перед ним, смотрит чуть мимо камеры на собеседницу (так задумано), губы приоткрыты, без надписей, в цвете
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary man (not a celebrity), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: ведущий подкаста ~42, серый свитер, тёплая студия с книгами
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic COLOUR frame from a video podcast. A confident friendly Russian man about 42 with short brown hair slightly grey at the temples, a short trimmed beard, a charcoal-grey knit sweater. He sits at a wooden desk, a black podcast microphone on a boom arm in front of his chest (NOT covering the mouth). He looks slightly to the right of the camera at a woman interlocutor (she is not in this frame), mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, calm half-smile in the eyes. Medium shot from the waist up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 14% below the upper edge. Background: cosy podcast studio with dark wooden bookshelves, warm table lamps, blurred. Natural warm colours, real high-end camera frame, NOT black-and-white, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
